attributes.tool.tavily_extract: Extract and process content from specific web pages. Use this tool when you have URLs and need to get the full text content from those pages. attributes.tool.tavily_map: Map and discover the structure of a website by finding all its URLs and pages. Use this tool when you need to understand a website's organization, find specific pages, or get an overview of all available content without extracting the actual text. Returns a structured list of URLs and their relationships. Useful for site exploration, finding documentation pages, or understanding how a website is organized.

Deere & Company engages in the manufacture and distribution of various equipment worldwide. The company operates through four segments: Production and Precision Agriculture, Small Agriculture and Turf, Construction and Forestry, and Financial Services. The Production and Precision Agriculture segment provides large and mid-size tractors, combines, cotton pickers and strippers, sugarcane harvesters and loaders, soil preparation, tillage, seeding, and crop care equipment, as well as application equipment, including sprayers and nutrient management, soil preparation machinery for grain growers, and related attachments and service parts. The Small Agriculture and Turf segment offers rotary mowers, hay and forage equipment, forage harvesters, utility tractors, and related loaders and attachments; turf and utility equipment, including riding lawn, commercial mowing, and golf course equipment, and utility vehicles; and other outdoor power products, as well as implements for mowing, tilling, snow and debris handling, aerating, residential, commercial, golf, and sports turf care applications. The Construction and Forestry segment provides backhoe loaders, crawler dozers and loaders, four-wheel-drive loaders, track loaders, excavators, motor graders, articulated dump trucks, landscape and skid-steer loaders, scraper systems, milling machines, recyclers, slipform and asphalt pavers, surface miners, compactors, tandem, static rollers, mobile crushers and screens, mobile and stationary asphalt plants, log skidders and harvesters, log feller bunchers, and log loaders and forwarders; and road building and rehabilitation equipment. The Financial Services segment finances sales and leases agriculture and turf, and construction and forestry equipment. It also offers wholesale financing to dealers of the foregoing equipment; and extended equipment warranties, as well as finances retail revolving charge accounts. The company was founded in 1837 and is headquartered in Moline, Illinois.

attributes.result.structuredContent.results.1.title: Deere’s 2026 Outlook Suggests No Farm Economy Uptick - Successful Farming
attributes.result.structuredContent.results.1.conte: Bloomberg’s Michael Hirtzer and Matthew Griffin reported that “Deere & Co.’s weak forecast for the year ahead reinforces the difficulty in predicting a recovery in the US farm economy as uncertainty continues to swirl over the impact of tariffs and trade deals.” “‘Our organization is used to managing cyclicality, but this year we faced an additional headwind of heightened uncertainty in a rapidly changing business environment,’ Chief Executive Officer John May said on a Wednesday call with investors,” Hirtzer and Griffin reported. Reuters Abhinav Parmar reported in early November that “farm and construction machinery maker CNH Industrial lowered its full-year profit forecast on Friday, as it intentionally scaled back production of tractors and combines to avoid a supply glut amid sluggish demand.”
attributes.result.structuredContent.results.2.title: Deere’s disappointing outlook shows farm recovery is elusive - Farm Progress
attributes.result.structuredContent.results.2.conte: Deere & Co.’s weak forecast for the year ahead reinforces the difficulty in predicting a recovery in the U.S. farm economy as uncertainty continues to swirl over the impact of tariffs and trade deals. While the recent deal with China is raising hopes, there’s still questions on whether the ramp-up of soybean and wheat sales will be enough to shake the US farm economy out of a years-long slump. Trump called for farmers to go buy tractors after the U.S.-China trade deal was announced, but it may take longer for those sales to materialize. Deere estimated 2026 sales for its large agriculture segment — which caters to the biggest farmers of crops such as corn and soybeans — to be down 15% to 20% in the U.S. and Canada.

Deere & Company engages in the manufacture and distribution of various equipment worldwide. The company operates through four segments: Production and Precision Agriculture, Small Agriculture and Turf, Construction and Forestry, and Financial Services. The Production and Precision Agriculture segment provides large and mid-size tractors, combines, cotton pickers and strippers, sugarcane harvesters and loaders, soil preparation, tillage, seeding, and crop care equipment, as well as application equipment, including sprayers and nutrient management, soil preparation machinery for grain growers, and related attachments and service parts. The Small Agriculture and Turf segment offers rotary mowers, hay and forage equipment, forage harvesters, utility tractors, and related loaders and attachments; turf and utility equipment, including riding lawn, commercial mowing, and golf course equipment, and utility vehicles; and other outdoor power products, as well as implements for mowing, tilling, snow and debris handling, aerating, residential, commercial, golf, and sports turf care applications. The Construction and Forestry segment provides backhoe loaders, crawler dozers and loaders, four-wheel-drive loaders, track loaders, excavators, motor graders, articulated dump trucks, landscape and skid-steer loaders, scraper systems, milling machines, recyclers, slipform and asphalt pavers, surface miners, compactors, tandem, static rollers, mobile crushers and screens, mobile and stationary asphalt plants, log skidders and harvesters, log feller bunchers, and log loaders and forwarders; and road building and rehabilitation equipment. The Financial Services segment finances sales and leases agriculture and turf, and construction and forestry equipment. It also offers wholesale financing to dealers of the foregoing equipment; and extended equipment warranties, as well as finances retail revolving charge accounts. The company was founded in 1837 and is headquartered in Moline, Illinois.

Deere & Company engages in the manufacture and distribution of various equipment worldwide. The company operates through four segments: Production and Precision Agriculture, Small Agriculture and Turf, Construction and Forestry, and Financial Services. The Production and Precision Agriculture segment provides large and mid-size tractors, combines, cotton pickers and strippers, sugarcane harvesters and loaders, soil preparation, tillage, seeding, and crop care equipment, as well as application equipment, including sprayers and nutrient management, soil preparation machinery for grain growers, and related attachments and service parts. The Small Agriculture and Turf segment offers rotary mowers, hay and forage equipment, forage harvesters, utility tractors, and related loaders and attachments; turf and utility equipment, including riding lawn, commercial mowing, and golf course equipment, and utility vehicles; and other outdoor power products, as well as implements for mowing, tilling, snow and debris handling, aerating, residential, commercial, golf, and sports turf care applications. The Construction and Forestry segment provides backhoe loaders, crawler dozers and loaders, four-wheel-drive loaders, track loaders, excavators, motor graders, articulated dump trucks, landscape and skid-steer loaders, scraper systems, milling machines, recyclers, slipform and asphalt pavers, surface miners, compactors, tandem, static rollers, mobile crushers and screens, mobile and stationary asphalt plants, log skidders and harvesters, log feller bunchers, and log loaders and forwarders; and road building and rehabilitation equipment. The Financial Services segment finances sales and leases agriculture and turf, and construction and forestry equipment. It also offers wholesale financing to dealers of the foregoing equipment; and extended equipment warranties, as well as finances retail revolving charge accounts. The company was founded in 1837 and is headquartered in Moline, Illinois.

attributes.result.structuredContent.results.1.title: Deere Q4 Earnings Miss Estimates, Sales Up Y/Y on Lower ...
attributes.result.structuredContent.results.1.conte: **Deere & Company** DE has reported fourth-quarter fiscal 2025 (ended Nov. 2, 2025) earnings of $3.93 per share, which missed the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $3.96. Net sales of equipment operations (comprising Agriculture, and Turf, Construction and Forestry) were $10.6 billion, up 14% year over year, surpassing the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $9.99 billion. Revenues in Deere’s Financial Services division were $1.55 billion in the reported quarter, up 2% year over year. Net income of Deere’s Financial Services division was $293 million in the reported quarter compared with $173 million in the prior-year quarter. Deere reported fiscal 2025 earnings of $18.50 per share, which missed the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $18.53. Net sales of equipment operations came in at $38.9 billion, down 13% year over year, surpassing the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $38.3 billion. In the third quarter, CNH Industrial’s revenues declined nearly 5% from the year-ago level to $4.4 billion but topped the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $4.3 billion.
attributes.result.structuredContent.results.2.title: Deere & Co (DE) Q4 2025 Earnings Call Highlights
attributes.result.structuredContent.results.2.conte: - Best Black Friday deals - Best money market accounts * **Fourth Quarter Equipment Operations Net Sales:** Up 14% to $10.6 billion. * **Production & Precision Ag Net Sales:** Fourth quarter sales up 10% to $4.74 billion. * **Small Ag & Turf Net Sales:** Fourth quarter sales up 7% to $2.457 billion. * Deere & Co (NYSE:DE) achieved over $5 billion in net income for fiscal 2025, reflecting strong financial performance amidst challenging market conditions. * The company reported a 14% increase in net sales for equipment operations in the fourth quarter, driven by higher shipment volumes and favorable price realization. * Net sales and revenues for fiscal 2025 were down 12%, with equipment operations sales down 13%, indicating a challenging year for the company.
attributes.result.structuredContent.results.3.title: Deere (DE) Q4 Earnings Miss Estimates
attributes.result.structuredContent.results.3.conte: Deere (DE) came out with quarterly earnings of $3.93 per share, missing the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $3.96 per share. Deere, which belongs to the Zacks Manufacturing - Farm Equipment industry, posted revenues of $10.58 billion for the quarter ended October 2025, surpassing the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 5.92%. While the magnitude and direction of estimate revisions could change following the company's just-released earnings report, the current status translates into a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) for the stock. The current consensus EPS estimate is $2.62 on $7.19 billion in revenues for the coming quarter and $19.43 on $40.03 billion in revenues for the current fiscal year. One other stock from the broader Zacks Industrial Products sector, Enerpac (EPAC), is yet to report results for the quarter ended November 2025. This industrial products company is expected to post quarterly earnings of $0.42 per share in its upcoming report, which represents a year-over-year change of +5%.
attributes.result.structuredContent.results.4.title: Compared to Estimates, Deere (DE) Q4 Earnings

Deere & Company engages in the manufacture and distribution of various equipment worldwide. The company operates through four segments: Production and Precision Agriculture, Small Agriculture and Turf, Construction and Forestry, and Financial Services. The Production and Precision Agriculture segment provides large and mid-size tractors, combines, cotton pickers and strippers, sugarcane harvesters and loaders, soil preparation, tillage, seeding, and crop care equipment, as well as application equipment, including sprayers and nutrient management, soil preparation machinery for grain growers, and related attachments and service parts. The Small Agriculture and Turf segment offers rotary mowers, hay and forage equipment, forage harvesters, utility tractors, and related loaders and attachments; turf and utility equipment, including riding lawn, commercial mowing, and golf course equipment, and utility vehicles; and other outdoor power products, as well as implements for mowing, tilling, snow and debris handling, aerating, residential, commercial, golf, and sports turf care applications. The Construction and Forestry segment provides backhoe loaders, crawler dozers and loaders, four-wheel-drive loaders, track loaders, excavators, motor graders, articulated dump trucks, landscape and skid-steer loaders, scraper systems, milling machines, recyclers, slipform and asphalt pavers, surface miners, compactors, tandem, static rollers, mobile crushers and screens, mobile and stationary asphalt plants, log skidders and harvesters, log feller bunchers, and log loaders and forwarders; and road building and rehabilitation equipment. The Financial Services segment finances sales and leases agriculture and turf, and construction and forestry equipment. It also offers wholesale financing to dealers of the foregoing equipment; and extended equipment warranties, as well as finances retail revolving charge accounts. The company was founded in 1837 and is headquartered in Moline, Illinois.

attributes.result.structuredContent.results.1.conte: The CEO said margin pressures from tariffs would continue to affect the company's large ag sector. attributes.result.structuredContent.results.2.title: Deere’s 2026 Outlook Suggests No Farm Economy Uptick - Successful Farming
attributes.result.structuredContent.results.2.conte: Bloomberg’s Michael Hirtzer and Matthew Griffin reported that “Deere & Co.’s weak forecast for the year ahead reinforces the difficulty in predicting a recovery in the US farm economy as uncertainty continues to swirl over the impact of tariffs and trade deals.” “‘Our organization is used to managing cyclicality, but this year we faced an additional headwind of heightened uncertainty in a rapidly changing business environment,’ Chief Executive Officer John May said on a Wednesday call with investors,” Hirtzer and Griffin reported. The plan successfully executed all steps to create a high-quality stock analysis report for Deere & Company.

Here's a summary of the execution and its outcome:

1.  **High-Quality Data Gathering (Step 1):** The `research_quality_controller` component was used to gather comprehensive financial data for Deere & Company. This included the current stock price ($380.00 as of May 24, 2024), recent stock movement (a 1.26% decline on the day of analysis, and a 4.7% drop post-Q2 earnings), the latest quarterly earnings results (Q2 2024 EPS of $6.51 beat estimates, but revenue of $13.618 billion missed, and net income declined 17.1% year-over-year), and recent news and developments (primarily analyst reactions and price target adjustments following the Q2 earnings and lowered full-year guidance). The research quality was confirmed to be 'GOOD'.

2.  **Financial Data Analysis (Step 2):** The gathered data was then thoroughly analyzed by the `financial_analyst`. This analysis identified key insights, highlighting the significant impact of the Q2 2024 earnings report. The lowered full-year net income outlook (revised to $7.00 billion - $7.50 billion from $7.75 billion - $8.25 billion) and the deteriorating fundamentals in the agricultural market were identified as major drivers of negative market sentiment. Despite an EPS beat, the revenue miss and guidance reduction led to a cautious short-term outlook and widespread price target reductions by analysts, although many maintained long-term positive ratings.

3.  **Comprehensive Report Generation (Steps 3-6):** Based on the analysis, a comprehensive and professional stock analysis report for Deere & Company was generated by the `report_writer`. The report, saved to "company_reports/deere_&_company_report_20251204_170518.md", includes:
    *   An **Executive Summary** providing a quick overview of the current price, market cap ($102.3 billion as of May 24, 2024), investment thesis, and a "Hold" recommendation (Medium Confidence).
    *   **Current Market Performance** details, including trading metrics (stock price, volume, 52-week range, current position relative to highs/lows) and technical analysis, noting the stock's volatility (Beta 1.15) and recent bearish momentum.
    *   **Financial Performance** section, covering the latest quarterly results (Q2 2024 EPS beat, revenue miss, and significant year-over-year declines in revenue and net income) and key financial metrics like the TTM P/E ratio (9.94), which is discounted due to current market conditions.
    *   **Recent Developments** summarizing market-moving news and analyst activity, detailing the numerous price target adjustments and the nuanced sentiment of short-term caution balanced with long-term belief in the company's fundamentals.
    *   A detailed **Investment Analysis** outlining both **Bull Case** strengths (market leadership, precision agriculture innovation, operational efficiency) and **Bear Case** concerns (weak agricultural market fundamentals, lowered guidance, elevated inventory levels, and broader economic slowdown impact).
    *   A **Valuation Assessment** that contextualizes the current stock price and P/E ratio in light of the cyclical downturn and analyst revisions.
    *   A clear **Recommendation** to "Hold."

The final report provides a professional, fact-based overview of Deere & Company's current financial health and investment outlook, reflecting the insights derived from the high-quality data and analysis.
